commands.review_summary:
The PR changes the Codex event projector to warn on protocol drift, map explicit unknown item statuses to failed while preserving statusless completions, adds focused tests, and adds a standalone proof harness script.

PR surface: Source +279, Tests +138. Total +417 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. Current main is source-reproducible: an explicit unrecognized Codex item status reaches itemStatus and returns completed, while current-turn unknown methods fall through without diagnostics; I did not run a local runtime repro in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] The current blocker is a narrow repair in the added proof harness; after that, maintainers still need to accept the fail-closed compatibility tradeoff.

target.title: fix(codex): fail closed on unknown projector statuses and warn on protocol drift
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #99269.

The Codex event projector had three fail-open or silent-drop paths that turned future Codex protocol drift into wrong results instead of diagnosable errors:

1. `itemStatus()` mapped any unrecognized item status to `"completed"`.
2. The notification dispatch `default:` case silently ignored unknown methods.
3. Thread/turn correlation mismatches were discarded without logging.

A follow-up concern from review: valid **statusless** items (e.g. `webSearch` completions) must remain `"completed"`, while only an **explicit unknown status value** should fail closed. Valid **unscoped/global** Codex notifications must also not be logged as active-turn drift.

## Why This Change Was Made

The harness pins `@openai/codex` 0.142.4 but accepts configured binaries down to the 0.125.0 floor, and the pin is bumped regularly. Status drift produces false success for failed tool calls, while silent drops make upgrade regressions look like nondeterministic model behavior.

`webSearch` and similar items legitimately omit the `status` field, so the missing-status path is preserved as `"completed"`.

## User Impact

Operators and developers will now see explicit warnings when the Codex projector encounters an unknown status value, unknown notification method, or unexpected thread/turn correlation. Unknown item statuses are treated as failures instead of successes, preventing the model from continuing on wrong premises. Statusless `webSearch` completions continue to project as completed, and unscoped/global notifications are not reported as drift.

## Evidence

### Unit-test coverage

Added regression tests in `extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts`:

- **Statusless `webSearch` completion** is projected as `"completed"` and does **not** log an unknown-status warning.
- Unknown item status (`"timedOut"`) is projected as `"failed"` with `isError: true` and emits the expected warning.
- Unknown notification methods emit the expected warning.
- Notifications for a different turn emit the expected warning with expected/actual thread and turn ids.
- Unscoped global notifications do **not** emit an active-turn mismatch warning.

### Upstream protocol check

Verified upstream Codex item status enum values (`inProgress | completed | failed | declined`) by inspecting the sibling `codex` checkout at `codex-rs/app-server-protocol/src/protocol/v2/item.rs`.

### Projector-harness proof (outside unit tests)

Ran the standalone projector harness at `extensions/codex/scripts/proof-protocol-drift.mts`. It drives `CodexAppServerEventProjector` directly through the five drift scenarios and prints the projected events and warnings.

```text
$ node_modules/.bin/tsx extensions/codex/scripts/proof-protocol-drift.mts
[agent/embedded] codex app-server unknown item status treated as failed
[agent/embedded] codex app-server unknown notification method
[agent/embedded] codex app-server notification does not match active turn
=== Codex app-server protocol drift projector-harness proof ===

1. Statusless webSearch completion:
   projected status: completed
   expected: completed

2. commandExecution with explicit unknown status 'timedOut':
   projected status: failed
   projected isError: true
   expected: failed / true

3. Warning log summary:
   - codex app-server unknown item status treated as failed
   - codex app-server unknown notification method
   - codex app-server notification does not match active turn

4. Checks:
   statusless webSearch -> completed: PASS
   unknown status -> failed + warning: PASS
   unknown method -> warning: PASS
   scoped mismatch -> warning: PASS
   unscoped global -> no drift warning: PASS

OVERALL: PASS
```

### Unit-test run

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts --reporter=verbose
...
✓ |extension-codex| ... > fail-closed diagnostics > treats statusless webSearch completions as completed
✓ |extension-codex| ... > fail-closed diagnostics > treats unknown item statuses as failed
✓ |extension-codex| ... > fail-closed diagnostics > does not warn on unscoped global notifications
✓ |extension-codex| ... > fail-closed diagnostics > warns on unknown notification methods
✓ |extension-codex| ... > fail-closed diagnostics > warns on notifications for a different turn

Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  130 passed (130)
```

### Formatting

`pnpm format:check` passes on the changed files.
